newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Q1 GDP growth seen at 3.9 pct - IPEA.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Q1 GDP growth seen at 3.9 pct - IPEA.

text.p: Brazil's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is forecast to grow 3.9 percent in the first quarter of 1997 over the same period of 1996, Brazil's Institute of Applied Economic Research (IPEA) in a statement.
The IPEA statement said January industrial output is seen growing 8.2 percent against January 1996 levels.
January industrial output is forecast to have risen 0.7 percent against December 1996 levels mainly due to a 7.1 percent increase in auto output.
IPEA, which reports to the Planning Ministry, said these indicators showed that the economy was likely to grow moderately in 1997.
